purpose: Separate zero-shot transport from target-regime adaptation and replace unstable source disagreement with cross-fitted target residual risk.
risk_model: ExtraTreesRegressor fitted to log1p absolute cross-fitted target residuals

success_rules.target_adaptation_support: positive R2 in both provided test and group-aware OOF evaluation for both outcomes
success_rules.risk_support: positive error correlation, normalized AURC below 1, and high-error capture above source disagreement
success_rules.interval_support: nominal coverage with width or Winkler improvement over constant conformal comparator
success_rules.same_regime_support: must be evaluated only after an external clear-wood file passes schema, units, protocol, clustering, and source-overlap audits

prohibited_actions: claim Spruce is same-regime clear wood
use external labels to redefine the regime gate
select a dataset because it gives positive R2
pool ASTM/COPANT/NBR records without standard stratification
claim a novel universally superior predictor
claim same-regime generalization before the LPF/SFB or another qualified clear-wood dataset is executed
